lessons.title: Deferred: restructure Step 2 into a native-first ladder
lessons.detail: This cycle fixed the individual vendor rows and added a 'check the app directory first' instruction, but the skill still presents webhooks as the default path and native apps as exceptions. The correct shape is an explicit ladder: check the Zapier app directory, then native app, then official vendor webhook, then Custom Request as last resort. Deferred to keep this cycle scoped to correctness.

lessons.title: Deferred: add Zapier Canvas to the product taxonomy
lessons.detail: Step 8 covers Copilot, Agents, Chatbots and MCP but omits Canvas (zapier.com/canvas, live). Zapier's own suite framing includes Canvas for process mapping, which is the natural entry point for a non-technical owner mapping an invoicing flow before building it. Deferred as an addition rather than a correction.

persistent_fail.title: Evidence gate passed on snippets echoed from the claim, not fetched from the source
persistent_fail.detail: Two fabricated or long-dead claims survived the v2.2.0 gate because their raw_snippet was derived from the claim text rather than from fetched page content. 'zapier-pricing-tiers-2026' asserted a Starter plan discontinued in April 2024 on the strength of raw_snippet 'Starter ... Professional'. 'green-invoice-mcp-link' asserted a directory listing that has never existed on the strength of raw_snippet 'green-invoice-mcp'. A one-or-two-token snippet that is a substring of the claim proves nothing. Future gates should reject any raw_snippet that is fully contained in the claim text, and should require a snippet long enough to be falsifiable.

persistent_fail.title: Troubleshooting sections can entrench a wrong mechanism
persistent_fail.detail: The Cardcom IndicatorUrl/GET/DealResponse error was not merely stated once; the Troubleshooting entry for 'Webhook not receiving data from Cardcom' instructed the reader to verify the IndicatorUrl, confirm production mode, and check that Catch Hook accepts GET. Every one of those steps pushes a user further from the real cause. When correcting a mechanism, always grep the Troubleshooting and Gotchas blocks for the same mechanism, not just the instructional steps.

persistent_fail.title: One dead source URL backing a multi-vendor table
persistent_fail.detail: A single evidence claim ('decimal-shekels-israeli-processors') sourced payload and unit claims for six separate vendors to one Cardcom KB URL, which now returns 523. Only the Cardcom portion was ever verifiable from that source. Per-vendor claims need per-vendor sources; where no public spec exists (Grow by Meshulam), the skill must say 'unverified' rather than assert field names.

persistent_fail.title: Third-party platform drift outran the review interval
persistent_fail.detail: Between v2.2.0 (2026-05-20) and this review, Zapier's plan lineup, WhatsApp app surface, app count and Israeli-vendor app coverage all moved, and Cardcom's documented webhook mechanism turned out to have been wrong since creation rather than drifted. For platform-wrapper skills, verify vendor API shape against a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger JSON) rather than a KB article: the spec is greppable, self-dating, and lets you prove a field name is ABSENT, which prose cannot.

unverified.detail: zapier.com/apps/payplus/integrations is live with New Approval / New Charge / New Invoice triggers and a Hebrew-language integration partner (Responder Live), strongly suggesting the Israeli PayPlus. The page states no nationality, so PayPlus was deliberately NOT added to the skill this cycle. Confirm identity and then add it: it appears to be the only Israeli payment gateway with a native Zapier trigger.

unverified.item: Grow by Meshulam webhook payload field names
unverified.detail: transaction_id / amount / payment_method / customer_name / customer_email / customer_phone are unsourced. developers.meshulam.co.il does not resolve. Marked unverified in both the skill and the reference.
docs.tranzila.com has no webhook or notification-URL page. The documented field names are legacy redirect-response params. Flagged in place rather than rewritten, pending merchant-panel confirmation.

The skill's 'GET Morning API: Find Documents' framing is wrong (search takes a JSON filter body), corrected to POST, but the exact path was not re-verified because the docs moved to developers.morning.co. Confirm the path on the new host.

unverified.item: Zapier free-plan entitlements for Tables, Interfaces and Copilot
unverified.detail: The pricing page enumerates task tiers, not product entitlements. The v2.2.0 claim that Tables and Interfaces are 'free on all plans' was removed from frontmatter but a softer statement remains in Step 7. Source precisely or soften further.
Not contradicted by any source, but not re-verified against the relocated docs either.
